name: MISSION/T_FTOFF.MIS
title: Free takeoff
briefing: Your alone with your Su-27, lightweight with no weapons or enemies ready for takeoff from runway 30 in Sebastopol.

name: MISSION/AIR1.MIS
title: Airmanship
briefing:
Choose PLAY from the FLIGHT menu. You can use the F keys (views) during the demo.
You can take control by pressing the key ESC

Take-off procedure is as follows -

Flaps down
Wheel brake on (key W)
Power to 100%
Wheel brake off
At 250 km/h raise nose 10 degrees
The SU27 will fly itself off the runway
Raise gear (key G)
At 100 m raise flaps

name: MISSION/AIR6.MIS
title: Airmanship - Formation flying
briefing:
Choose PLAY from the FLIGHT menu. You can use the F keys (views) during the demo.
You can take control by pressing the key ESC

Your task is to fly in formation with the lead aircraft.

In formation flying the key is to make small adjustments of power and stick and anticipate the effects of your adjustments.

name: MISSION/SHIP1.MIS
title: Demonstration in the use of the anti-ship Kh-35 Missile
briefing:
Choose PLAY from the FLIGHT menu. You can use the F (view) keys during the demo. You can take control by pressing key ESC

WEAPON                Kh-35 - sea skimming, must be launched over the sea

Launch range          up to 130 km.
Launch altitude        50 - 15000m
Launch type             Fire and forget

DELIVERY PROCEDURE

Select Air2ground mode - key 4
Select missile - use Caps Lock key to cycle through missile types available
Switch on radar in Scan mode - key I
Switch to Search in Wide Area mode - key +
Search by using the coolie hat or keys ; , . /
Switch to Search in Narrow Area mode - key +
Place the cross hairs on the target and switch to Autotrack mode - key TAB

name: MISSION/T_A2A.MIS
title: Air Combat
briefing:
Your alone with your Su-27, armed with a wide selection of AAM. The enemy will turn up.
Scan by switching to Beyond visual range (BVR) by pressing 2,  activate your radar press I and start scanning. Press 3 for Close Air Combat (CAC). Press 6 for Helmet Mounted Target Designator (HMTD). Press * to Padlock. TAB for Lock On. Good luck.

name: MISSION/T_CAS_1.MIS
title: CAS on Razdolny Airport
briefing:
Use the Mission Editor to evaluate your mission.
You mission is in white.
Point to one of your waypoints and click the right mouse button.
Choose properties.

name: MISSION/T_PINP.MIS
title: Pinpoint Strike training
briefing:
Take off from Simferopol
Kh-29 TV guided and Kh-31p anti-radiation missilles
Hit SAM risk first then Saki airfield tower

name: MISSION/T_FREEF.MIS
title: Free flight
briefing: Your alone with your Su-27, lightweight with no weapons or enemies.
